messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-8321 fired for service=redwood-api (route=text.generate). Condition: p99 latency > 1200ms over 5m. Autopager suppression window active (quiet hours). No automatic page sent. Manual escalation recommended.

sara: saw this — p99 up to ~1.4s across eu-west. Grafana heatmap: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/p99/text-generate?orgId=1&from=now-10m

jon: thanks. Are requests backing up or just tail latency? any error spikes?

sara: error rate normal, qps slightly elevated (10%). Looks like KV cache eviction rates spiked (evictions/sec ~ 230) around same time.

alex: are we seeing kvcache throttle logs? paste relevant blocks:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] kvcache: evict=230 free_mem=420MB threshold=500MB
[2026-03-15T10:12:10Z] scheduler: batch_size=64 -> 32 due to backpressure
```

maya: PD incident created PD-8321. I manually paged oncall to override suppression — @sara please ack when you start triage.

sara: acked. on it. first goal: prevent customer impact. temp mitigation suggestions: 1) increase kvcache size on sidecars in eu-west from 500MB->1GB; 2) scale dedicated pool min replicas +1; 3) route heavy customers to fallback model variant.

jon: doing quick scale: `kubectl scale deploy/redwood-sidecar --replicas=18 -n eu-west` — rolling update in progress. monitor logs.

sara: started cache size bump via config rollout (feature-flagged). will let it roll to 50% then 100% if metrics improve. toggled `kvcache.max_mem_mb=1024` on canary.

incident-bot: PD PD-8321 acked by sara. Escalation path: if no improvement in 10m, escalate to senior oncall @liz and open bridge.

alex: if cache bump fails, we should fallback routing: `reroute-policy set --route text.generate --fallback model=gpt-small-quantized` (runbook step 4)

maya: customer-impact check: support dashboard shows 12 support tickets flagged high pri for delayed responses in last 8m, top customers: AcmeCorp, NovaAI. Notify CSMs?

sara: yes please ping CSMs. @jon can you send a quick status note to csm-ops with PD link and mitigation steps?

jon: posted to #customer-success: "PD-8321: p99 latency spike in eu-west. Mitigation: cache size bump + scale. Will update in 10m."

sara: metrics trending down — p99 at 980ms, p95 back to 220ms. continuing to monitor. keeping PD open until stable 15m.

maya: noted. I'll keep escalation on standby. thanks all.

sara: handing off to night oncall @liz at 10:40Z — will include runbook link and actions taken: cache bump canary deployed, scaled sidecars, no errors. last check-in: p99 780ms.

liz: thx, I'll monitor and ramp down scale when stable. closing thread if no regressions.
